mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate level below 1.5% signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate below 4.0% indicates a tight labor market that supports wage growth and corporate profit margins, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment growth (PAYEMS > 0.5% MoM) and unemployment decline (UNRATE < 0.2% MoM) signal accelerating labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS increases by >0.5% MoM and UNRATE decreases by >0.2% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1200 thousand units indicate robust consumer demand for housing, correlating with sustained economic expansion and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST exceeds 1200.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 105 (index 2017=100) reflects strong manufacturing output and economic activity, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO exceeds 105.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPIAUCSL above 250 and FEDFUNDS below 1.5% signal policy response to inflation that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 250 and FEDFUNDS is below 1.5.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales above 490,000 million dollars (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer spending that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS exceeds 490,000.

mechanism_narrative: A high housing starts level (HOUST) is consistently associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to sustained consumer demand and economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST exceeds 1200.
